name: Realtime transcription sessions
summary: Dedicated Realtime WebSocket sessions for streaming transcription only (no assistant response); `model` nested under `session.audio.input.transcription.model` (e.g. `gpt-realtime-whisper`).
description: Realtime transcription uses the Foundry OpenAI WebSocket endpoint (`wss://.../openai/v1/realtime`) to stream audio and receive transcripts without an assistant response. The transcription model is `gpt-realtime-whisper`, `gpt-4o-transcribe`, or `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`, selected in the realtime session rather than as a normal request model.
notes: No BYOM probe is meaningful: the transcription model is selected by the deployment in the WebSocket URL or `session.update.audio.input.transcription.model`, not by a top-level `model` field that can carry `{connection}/{deployment}`. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/openai/how-to/realtime-audio.
